meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

copy.tagline: 将 OpenClaw 配置迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw configuration to NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are migrating from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2

howto.what: 当用户要求从OpenClaw迁移时，Claude会检测现有安装，提取身份、渠道凭据、计划任务等配置，分阶段引导用户迁移到NanoClaw v2。过程中询问选择、展示拟议更改、创建迁移状态文件，最后应用更改并运行测试。
howto.when: 当用户说出“migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration”或“import from openclaw”等触发词，或要求从OpenClaw迁移到NanoClaw v2时触发。
howto.what_en: When asked to migrate from OpenClaw, Claude detects the install, extracts identity, channels, scheduled tasks, and config, then guides interactive migration to NanoClaw v2. It queries choices, shows proposed edits, writes a state file, then applies changes and runs tests.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'migrate from openclaw', 'openclaw migration', or 'import from openclaw', or when the user asks to migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2.

say_en.text: Help me migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2
I want to import my config from OpenClaw
say_en.note: Claude asks choices and migrates step by step.
